properties.name: management.tracing.baggage.correlation.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable correlation of the baggage context with logging contexts.

properties.name: management.tracing.baggage.correlation.fields
properties.description: List of fields that should be correlated with the logging context. That means that these fields would end up as key-value pairs in e.g. MDC.

properties.name: management.tracing.baggage.enabled
properties.description: Whether to enable Micrometer Tracing baggage propagation.

properties.name: management.tracing.baggage.local-fields
properties.description: List of fields that should be accessible within the JVM process but not propagated over the wire. Local fields are not supported with OpenTelemetry.

properties.name: management.tracing.baggage.remote-fields
properties.description: List of fields that are referenced the same in-process as it is on the wire. For example, the field "x-vcap-request-id" would be set as-is including the prefix.

properties.name: management.tracing.baggage.tag-fields
properties.description: List of fields that should automatically become tags.

properties.name: management.tracing.exemplars.include
properties.description: Traces to include as exemplars. 'all' is not supported when using Prometheus.

properties.name: management.tracing.export.enabled
properties.description: Whether auto-configuration of tracing is enabled to export and propagate traces.

properties.name: management.tracing.propagation.consume
properties.description: Tracing context propagation types consumed by the application.

properties.name: management.tracing.propagation.produce
properties.description: Tracing context propagation types produced by the application.

properties.name: management.tracing.propagation.type
properties.description: Tracing context propagation types produced and consumed by the application. Setting this property overrides the more fine-grained propagation type properties.

properties.name: management.tracing.sampling.probability
properties.description: Probability in the range from 0.0 to 1.0 that a trace will be sampled.
